essence: Ten scriptural names, one awareness-primacy: each name denotes by its office — chief-form, speech, ground-fullness, join-loose-lower, no-other-needed, yogin-like raising, mine-flashing, untrifling, rest-ground, still-shimmer.

sections.SUMMARY: The canon trumpets a single awareness-primacy across scriptures; ten names each denote by office — chief-form, speech, ground-fullness, join-loose-lower, no-other-needed, yogin-like raising, mine-flashing, untrifling, rest-ground, still-shimmer.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta of one referent in ten dialects
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: ten trumpets, one referent, each name earning its note. Canonical chorus relished.
